1.consolidated_definition: . Pertenece esta planta a las amarantáceas. Es de flores pequeñas y semillas que se adhieren a la ropa de las gentes y el pelaje de los animales, para propagarse. Abunda en cafetales y bosques, y en las regiones bajas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: This plant belongs to the amaranth family. It has small flowers and seeds that adhere to people's clothing and animals' fur for propagation. It is abundant in coffee plantations and forests, particularly in low-lying areas.
